scientific_integrity: Source periodic rapidities and the numerical checker were independently compared to the stated proof. The exact assertions follow analytically; finite checks are supplementary. Original exact-band formulas are credited; the derived arithmetic law is not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the exact periodic rapidity-gap convention with 0<a<b, g>0 and no intercell/on-site dissipation. It does not infer uniqueness of a steady state, a positive gap after removal of all zero modes, or perturbative robustness. The N^-4 near-resonance statement concerns infinite subsequences, not every size.
title: Arithmetic finite-size gap law for a dissipative SSH ring
